title: AttemptResponse
description: The name the attempt's worktrees are cut under, and the worktrees of earlier attempts that were set aside and removed; their branches stay.

name.description: The slice's name for its first attempt, and the name with -again- and the attempt's count after that, such as TD1-again-2.

cleared.description: The folders of earlier attempts that were removed, such as .forge/worktrees/TD1-tests-1.
